title: Remediation Canvas: interactive tasklets and safe-replay for support
creator: Maria Santos
description:
Goal: Ship a lightweight, interactive 'Remediation Canvas' that lets oncall/support operators compose, preview, and execute runbook tasklets safely. The canvas should make common remediation paths discoverable (restart, cache-warm, route-fallback, scale-task), enable parameterized inputs, and provide a deterministic safe-replay mode for post-incident audits.

Scope:
- Canvas UI: drag-and-drop tasklet blocks, editable parameters, conditional edges.
- Tasklet runtime: lightweight server-side task runner with explicit idempotency keys and a dry-run mode.
- Safety gates: RBAC checks, policy validators (no destructive commands without approval), rate-limits and simulated dry-run.
- Telemetry: emit structured events for every canvas edit/execute; tie to incident traces and cost/latency telemetry.
- Replay harness: store immutable execution logs + inputs to reproduce / debug.

Non-goals for this ticket: full DSL for arbitrary scripts, replacing existing full-featured runbook engine, multi-tenant admin console items. Those will be future follow-ups.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Canvas UI prototype wired to a stubbed tasklet runtime available behind feature flag.
2) Two production-grade tasklets implemented: "Restart Worker Pool" (safe, idempotent) and "Promote Fallback Model" (checks policy and preview).
3) Dry-run mode that simulates effects and surfaces potential side-effects in UI.
4) Execution logs stored to S3 and viewable in the Console runbook history panel.
5) Telemetry events emitted and visible on internal dashboard (tasklet.exec.*, tasklet.preview.*).

Risks & Mitigations:
- Risk: accidental destructive actions. Mitigation: enforce policy validators + approval flow + explicit confirmation UI.
- Risk: inconsistent replay. Mitigation: immutable inputs + idempotency keys + version pinning of tasklet handlers.
- Risk: operator confusion. Mitigation: include inline examples, prebuilt templates, and an onboarding 'safe-playground' mode.

Rollout plan: internal alpha -> SRE + Solutions Eng -> staged enablement for high-trust customers (opt-in) -> GA in console-2026.04.
